Packaging claim: Frost-Free Freezers Fire Heaters On Purpose
Core fact: Automatic-defrost freezers periodically activate a defrost heater to melt frost from the evaporator coils.
Second reveal: During the defrost cycle the compressor and fans can stop; the brief controlled heating is part of keeping the freezer working without manual defrosting.
First-frame and mechanism proof: A frost-free freezer paired with a clearly labelled, licensed local cutaway video showing its defrost heater at the evaporator; generic freezer exteriors do not prove heating.
Search queries: frost free freezer; freezer evaporator frost; refrigerator defrost heater
Fact boundaries: Do not claim every freezer has a heater; manual-defrost and some compact models differ. Do not imply food is intentionally warmed or thawed.
